A [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Mugaar)|Jedi Master]] piloted a '''''Defender''-class light corvette''' while leading a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] border patrol during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], but the ship was destroyed when the patrol was lured to the [[Mugaar system/Legends|Mugaar system]] and [[Battle of Mugaar|ambushed]] by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial forces]].
